items.title: CAS here to stay, liquidity will pick up, says Sebi Chief
items.description: Sebi chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated the closing auction session is here to stay.  He acknowledged initial liquidity concerns, which have improved in other markets.  Pandey mentioned Sebi will soon issue a consultation paper on the CAS framework.  Some market participants praised the implementation, especially during MSCI rebalancing events.  However, a segment of the market faces impacts due to settlement price dependency.

items.title: Canara Bank eyes $2 billion via overseas bonds
items.description: Canara Bank intends to raise two billion dollars from international markets. This significant funding will be secured through its medium term note program. The bank plans to mobilize these funds via its Gift City branch. Senior unsecured foreign currency bonds will be issued for this purpose. This initiative aims to bolster the bank's overseas financial capabilities.

items.title: BSE tech glitch disrupts F&O trading on Sensex expiry day
items.description: On Thursday, the BSE faced technical difficulties, leading to obstacles in executing trades related to futures and options during the crucial weekly Sensex expiry. According to the exchange, there was a short outage that affected specific segments of the cash market. Fortunately, normal operations resumed once the issue was addressed, although brokers reported similar disruptions on their trading platforms that were subsequently rectified.

items.title: These large- and mid-cap stocks with ‘Strong Buy’ & ‘Buy’ recos have upside potential of up to 28%, according to analysts
items.description: With each passing day, things are getting more complicated in the Gulf region – as well as in the market. When will things get sorted out? No one knows, and anyone claiming otherwise is indulging in guesswork. So, be ready to see a decline in the value of the stocks you hold or buy for some time at least, if not more. And the chances are that volatility will continue in most emerging markets, including India, even if the war ends tomorrow.

items.title: NPA provisions fall for second straight quarter as bank asset quality improves
items.description: Aggregate loan loss provisioning by banks dropped significantly year-on-year. This decline was driven by improving asset quality and fewer fresh slippages. Provision coverage ratios also reduced the need for fresh funds. Public sector banks saw a 19.8 percent fall in provisioning. Private sector banks registered a sharper 33.6 percent reduction in provisioning.

items.title: Stocks in news: Canara Bank, Vodafone Idea, Premier Energies and ACME Solar
items.description: Indian equity markets saw a slight recovery on Thursday after recent declines. Canara Bank plans to raise substantial funds through bond issuances. Vodafone Idea is set to receive significant debt financing from lenders. Premier Energies and RCT India will form a joint venture for battery manufacturing. Several other companies reported corporate actions and developments.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: On Thursday, Indian benchmark indices started with little movement, remaining in a narrow range as traders reacted to the elevated crude oil prices that dampened investor sentiment. However, a boost from the Closing Auction Session allowed the indices to make a comeback and finish positively for the day. While foreign portfolio investors offloaded shares, domestic institutional investors stepped in as net buyers.

items.title: Gujarat Fluorochemicals shares up 34% in 3 months: What’s driving the rally?
items.description: The shares of Gujarat Fluorochemicals have experienced notable growth, driven by strong results from the June quarter. The company is gearing up for significant capital investments to broaden its reach in advanced fluoropolymers, strategically targeting booming markets like semiconductors and green hydrogen. Additionally, the shift towards battery materials is poised to act as a crucial source of growth, leading to enhanced earnings and returns in the near future.

items.title: Advent, Temasek in talks for Fairfax stake in IIFL Fin
items.description: Advent International and Temasek Holdings are reportedly in talks to acquire Fairfax Financial's stake. Fairfax is looking to exit IIFL Finance as part of its IDBI Bank acquisition plan. This stake sale will help Fairfax comply with regulations and fund the IDBI Bank buyout. Fairfax currently holds a significant stake in IIFL Finance, which is valued at approximately ₹3,500 crore.

items.title: Canara HSBC Life fined Rs 1 crore for mis-selling policy to 88-yr-old via Canara Bank
items.description: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company received a ₹1 crore penalty from IRDAI. The fine was imposed for mis-selling a deferred annuity policy to an 88-year-old individual. IRDAI identified several procedural and disclosure deficiencies in the sales process. The insurer subsequently refunded ₹4.09 lakh to the affected customer. This action highlights regulatory scrutiny over insurance sales practices.

items.title: 'Fintechs must treat data as fiduciary duty, not business asset,' says RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra
items.description: Reserve Bank of India governor Sanjay Malhotra stressed data fiduciary responsibility for fintechs.  He stated that user data must be treated as a trustee asset, not a business asset.  Firms must use data strictly within user consent, protecting it diligently.  He warned that eroding trust through data misuse leads to irreversible damage.  Operational resilience and cybersecurity are essential for firms achieving significant scale.

items.title: SBI chief Setty says $127 billion FCNR inflow won’t trigger lending surge
items.description: State Bank of India Chairman CS Setty addressed concerns regarding foreign currency deposit inflows. He stated these funds will be absorbed gradually over the coming months. The central bank's swap facility attracted significant foreign capital inflows. Commercial banks received substantial FCNR(B) deposits, exceeding market expectations. Setty also highlighted structural shifts towards asset tokenization in capital markets.

items.title: $4 billion CIO Nimesh Chandan spots 4 bullish signals for Indian stocks. What changed?
items.description: India’s stock market is poised for a broader recovery as four core cycles—macroeconomics, corporate earnings, credit growth, and market sentiment—align positively. Nimesh Chandan, CIO of Bajaj Finserv AMC, highlights these improving indicators as a key foundation for sustained equity growth, provided earnings momentum continues and global market headwinds soften.

items.title: The “other Hero” comes to Dalal Street: A Munjal family story with a market twist
items.description: Hero Motors, the Munjal family-controlled automotive technology company, is set to enter Dalal Street with a Rs 1,000 crore IPO. The company, distinct from listed Hero MotoCorp, traces its roots to the Hero Group and has expanded into powertrain systems and components for global automotive and mobility customers.

items.title: 10 smallcap stocks zoom up to 235% in 1 year; 8 turn multibaggers! Own any?
items.description: The stock market’s strongest performers can often reveal where investor interest and momentum have been concentrated. Here are 10 stocks that have delivered notable gains over the past year, with each recording a rise of more than 96%. Do you own any?

items.title: SBI's 80 paise masterstroke: How NSE IPO could deliver Rs 2,850 crore jackpot and 2,23,025% return
items.description: SBI is set to potentially book a massive profit from the NSE IPO by selling up to 1.60 crore shares acquired at a weighted-average cost of just 80 paise each. At the upper price band of Rs 1,785, the stake sale could fetch around Rs 2,850 crore, implying a staggering 223,025% return.

items.title: ESDS Software Solution jumps 5%, extends 6-session rally; shares up 287% from IPO price
items.description: ESDS Software Solution shares extended their post-listing rally to six sessions, surging 287% from the IPO price. Strong issue demand, rising investor optimism around data centres and improved FY26 profitability have added momentum to the stock.

items.title: BSE shares fall 3% as rival NSE gets closer to mega IPO. More pain ahead?
items.description: BSE shares fell on Friday after rival NSE announced its Rs 22,662-crore IPO, with the issue set to open on September 17. Bernstein has an ‘Underperform’ rating on BSE, citing moderating retail participation and potential peaking of market share gains in FY27. The stock remains sharply higher over longer periods.

items.title: From 52% to 42%: Is HDFC Bank’s 10 percentage point drop in FII shareholding a worrying sign?
items.description: HDFC Bank has seen a sharp decline in foreign investor ownership since its merger with HDFC, reflecting concerns over slower growth, funding pressures, margins and leadership changes. FII holding has fallen from 52.13% in September 2023 to 41.82% in June 2026. While valuations have become more attractive, investors await clearer signs of improving growth, profitability and post-merger execution.

items.title: Vedanta, Vedanta Aluminium, NALCO, other metal stocks fall up to 5% on Friday. Here’s why
items.description: Metal stocks fell as soaring oil prices, rising US bond yields and a stronger dollar weighed on sentiment. Vedanta, Vedanta Aluminium, Hindustan Copper, Tata Steel and JSW Steel declined 3–5%. The US 10-year Treasury yield rose above 4.9%, its highest since 2023, as higher oil prices stoked inflation concerns and raised expectations of a potential Fed rate hike.

items.title: Rs 2.8 lakh crore out, Rs 47,000 crore in: Why FIIs are selling listed stocks but chasing IPOs
items.description: FIIs are increasingly turning to India’s primary market even as they withdraw heavily from listed stocks. Foreign investors have pulled nearly Rs 2.8 lakh crore from the secondary market in 2026 but invested over Rs 47,000 crore in IPOs. The shift reflects a preference for new sectors, large allocations at predetermined prices and greater control over entry costs.

items.title: PVR Inox among 3 stocks closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: The closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1.5% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price) on September 10, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Why is market falling today? War woes, oil spike and 4 other factors behind Rs 5 lakh cr D-Street rout
items.description: Indian stock markets tumbled significantly on Friday, with benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty recording considerable dips. The sharp surge in crude oil prices coupled with increasing bond yields rattled investors, leading to a staggering loss of over Rs 5 lakh crore in total market capitalisation. After a day of volatile trading, both indices closed well in the red.

items.title: Sterlite Tech shares in focus as firm secures US certification for AI data centre fibre assemblies
items.description: Sterlite Technologies secured US certification for its indoor optical fibre assemblies designed for AI data centres. The company is targeting Rs 20,000 crore revenue by FY29, while strong Q1 results and AI-led demand have driven a sharp rally in its shares.

items.title: NSE IPO: 8 selling shareholders trim stake sale as offer size cut by over 15%, RHP shows
items.description: NSE has reduced its IPO offer for sale to 12.64 crore shares from 14.89 crore shares, with eight shareholders cutting their proposed stake sale. The Rs 22,561 crore IPO will open on September 17, with shares priced at Rs 1,700-1,785.

items.title: IRB Infrastructure among 6 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On September 10, six Nifty500 stocks that gained over 4% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, suggesting strengthening momentum in the price of the stock. This can indicate potential upward movement and may be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Acutaas Chemicals among 4 Nifty500 stocks flashing bullish signals
items.description: On September 10, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 4% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level towards the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: NSE IPO price band for Rs 22,561-crore offer announced! Check key dates, other important details
items.description: Retail investors have been allocated 35% of the issue, while 50% has been reserved for eligible institutional bidders (QIBs). The remaining portion will be available to non-institutional investors (NIIs).
